subject: Classwork update after your reply
text:
Your last message made me laugh, and it also helped me finally understand the reading schedule. I went back to the module after work and realized I had been mixing up the case study questions with the weekly reflection prompts. The fix was simpler than I thought: the instructor wants the short responses in the discussion tab, not the assignment folder. I went ahead and drafted a response for the first section, so we can compare notes if you are still looking for a second reader. The classmate who mentioned the group chat also passed along a useful outline, and it looks close to what you shared yesterday. I think the only change I need to make is adding a transition sentence before the conclusion, because my argument jumps from the timeline to the recommendation too quickly. If you want, we can swap drafts before the deadline and keep this low pressure. No need to stay up late over the formatting details, since the grading note says clarity matters more than length. I hope your week settles into something less chaotic, and I hope the neighborly offer of coffee and proofreading still stands.

Take care,
